task_title: Implement output directory and filename policy
acceptance_criteria: src/recording/OutputPathPolicy.hpp exists and declares OutputPathPolicy with resolveOutputPath and validate public interface
src/recording/OutputPathPolicy.cpp exists and implements placeholder resolution for {date}, {time}, {datetime}, {source}, {format}, {samplerate}, {channels}, {counter}
OutputPathPolicy creates the output directory if it does not exist
OutputPathPolicy handles filename collisions with incrementing suffixes
OutputPathPolicy validates that the base directory is writable
Implementation uses only C++ standard library, no Qt dependency
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
stdout:
I have implemented [`OutputPathPolicy`](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/python/abracapture/src/recording/OutputPathPolicy.hpp) and [`CaptureMetadata`](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/python/abracapture/src/recording/OutputPathPolicy.hpp#L10-L17) in `src/recording/OutputPathPolicy.hpp` and `src/recording/OutputPathPolicy.cpp`.

### Summary of Changes

1. **[`src/recording/OutputPathPolicy.hpp`](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/python/abracapture/src/recording/OutputPathPolicy.hpp)**:
   - Declared [`CaptureMetadata`](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/python/abracapture/src/recording/OutputPathPolicy.hpp#L10-L17) holding `source`, `sampleRate`, `channels`, `format`, `counter`, and `timestamp`.
   - Declared [`OutputPathPolicy`](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/python/abracapture/src/recording/OutputPathPolicy.hpp#L19-L43) with configuration parameters (base output directory, filename template, default format extension) and public methods:
     - [`resolveOutputPath(metadata)`](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/python/abracapture/src/recording/OutputPathPolicy.hpp#L35)
     - [`validate()`](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/python/abracapture/src/recording/OutputPathPolicy.hpp#L36)

2. **[`src/recording/OutputPathPolicy.cpp`](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/python/abracapture/src/recording/OutputPathPolicy.cpp)**:
   - Implemented template placeholder substitution for `{date}`, `{time}`, `{datetime}`, `{source}`, `{format}`, `{samplerate}`, `{channels}`, and `{counter}`, sanitizing filename characters and validating placeholder syntax.
   - Handled automatic output directory creation with `std::filesystem::create_directories`.
   - Implemented numeric suffix collision resolution (`_001`, `_002`, etc.) when candidate paths exist.
   - Implemented [`validate()`](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/python/abracapture/src/recording/OutputPathPolicy.cpp#L69-L124) writability checking for the configured base directory.
   - Built exclusively using the C++ standard library (`<filesystem>`, `<chrono>`, `<sstream>`, `<iomanip>`) with zero Qt dependencies.

### Verification

- Passed syntax verification: `g++ -std=c++20 -fsyntax-only src/recording/OutputPathPolicy.cpp -I src`
- Passed Qt isolation check: `! grep -q '#include.*<Q' src/recording/OutputPathPolicy.hpp src/recording/OutputPathPolicy.cpp`
- Validated placeholder expansion, directory creation, collision avoidance, and invalid placeholder rejection via unit tests.
